A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the neutral current has to be of the form (gV + gA gamma5) (V + A gamma5), where gV and gA are the vector and axial-vector couplings of the weak interaction and V and A are the isotopic vector and axial-vector currents, respectively.
the neutral current has a V, A structure and a significant isotopic vector part.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the neutral current is not a simple sum of the vector and axial-vector currents.
